{{Top|leg}}
The '''Coynite language''' was spoken by the [[Coynite/Legends|Coynites]].

==Glossary==
*''Af'harl'' &mdash; "cowardly deceiver" (probably the worst curse of all)<ref name="PoG3">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref>
*''Af'tah'' &mdash; "deception"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Ag'Tra]]'' &mdash; "Nobles"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Ah'Kra]]'' &mdash; a city<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Ah'Kra'Tais]]'' &mdash; "Common-craftersland" (a starport)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Arqua'Tais]]'' &mdash; "Land of Fallen Ones of Valor" (a cemetery)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Ba'Har]]'' &mdash; "battle blade" (fourth planet of the Coyn system)<ref name="PoG3" />
*[[Kaine Paulsen|Chu'la]]-cunning little fox
*''[[Coyn]]'' &mdash; "land of conflict and blood"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Coyn'skar]]'' &mdash; bladed polearm<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Coyn'Skraj'Har]]'' &mdash; "Corn-sky-blade" (Coyn's space fleet)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Coynek]]'' &mdash; "light of land of conflict and blood" (Coyn system star)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[D'skar]]'' &mdash; "dagger"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[D'Skar]]'' &mdash; "dagger" (first planet of the Coyn system)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[En'Tra]]'' &mdash; "King-Master"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[En'Tra'Ag'Tra]]'' &mdash; "King-Master's highest-servants"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[En'Tra'Sol]]'' &mdash; "King-Law"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''En'Tra'Sol'Tais'Tra'' &mdash; "King-Master of Law, Land and Cities (formal title of the En'Tra)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[En'Tra'Tais]]'' &mdash; "Kingland" (a starport)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[En'Tra'Tal]]'' &mdash; a city<ref name="PoG3" />
*''Fas'tracc'sorr'' &mdash; end of submission and blood loyalty (a declaration)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''Fa'tar'' &mdash; "peace" (a curse)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''Harl'tah'' &mdash; "cowardice"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Im'Tra'Tais]]'' &mdash; "Princeland" (a starport)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Im'Tra'Tal]]'' &mdash; a city<ref name="PoG3" />
*''Kars'asruul'' &mdash; "soulrider"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Kezz'Sreik'Kuras]]'' &mdash; a constellation<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Kra]]'' &mdash; a city<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Kra'Tais]]'' &mdash; "Craftersland" (a starport)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Kroyn]]'' &mdash; elite warrior<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Kroyn'Tais]]'' &mdash; "Warriorland" (a starport)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Kroyn'Tal]]'' &mdash; a city<ref name="PoG3" />
*''Kzah'' &mdash; "poison" (a curse and the substance)<ref name="PoG3" />
*[[Drake Paulsen|Lom]]-freedom
*Lom'Ka'Sol-out of the cradle.
*''Mora'ga'' &mdash; weakness (a curse)<ref name="PoG3" />
*Rattar—Friendship.
*''[[Rols'Kus]]'' &mdash; "arena of the games"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Sarrh'Tais]]'' &mdash; "lawland"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Sat'skar]]'' &mdash; "sword"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Sar'Skar]]'' &mdash; "sword" (second planet of the Coyn system)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''Sat'skars Fas'Ba'' &mdash; "Swords ended in battle" (meaning that there remain unresolved differences that will not be forgotten)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''Sat'skars Fas'Tawws'Rattar'' &mdash; "Swords ended in honor and friendship" (which means all conflicts have been satisfactorily resolved, thus we are friends)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''Sat'skars Kabar'Ba'' &mdash; "Swords together, joined in battle" (a challenge to battle or warning that animosity exists and great care should be taken or a challenge to combat will be made)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''Sat'skars Kabar'Rattar'' &mdash; "Swords together, blunted in friendship" (a greeting)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Skraj'Tais]]'' &mdash; "Skyland" (orbital space station)<ref name="PoG3" />
*''Sratt'' &mdash; word or promise<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Tawws'Kroyn]]'' &mdash; "Most Honorable Champion Warrior"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''Tracc'sorr'' &mdash; "submission and blood loyalty" or "fealty"<ref name="PoG3" />
*''[[Tro'Har]]'' &mdash; "farthest blade" (fifth planet of the Coyn system)<ref name="PoG3" />
*Tu'pah-child, infant.
*''[[Var'sairk]]'' &mdash; "birth-group" or litter<ref name="PoG3" />
*Zal'Tra—Security Force rank - junior rank.
*Zee'tah &mdash; "fear" (a curse)<ref name="PoG3" />
